event.dorian_heart2.0.text: Shh. Slowly. Stand where I am. Look.
event.dorian_heart2.0.why: pulls the player into his stillness before showing anything

event.dorian_heart2.1.text: A fox. By the fern. Don't move. She's deciding about you.
event.dorian_heart2.1.why: specific animal and place; the fox judging the player is the soft joke

event.dorian_heart2.2.text: These were by her den. Take them. Not me. The forest.
event.dorian_heart2.2.why: turns the mushroom gift into his signature offering

event.dorian_heart5.0.text: Here. Step over the root. This is my spot.
event.dorian_heart5.0.why: concrete, physical arrival instead of an announcement

event.dorian_heart5.1.text: I've never shown anyone. Edmund found it once. On his own.
event.dorian_heart5.1.why: keeps the confession, adds the farm's own history

event.dorian_heart5.2.text: Keep it to yourself. The truffle under the oak is yours.
event.dorian_heart5.2.why: the secret plus the gift, pointed at a real tree

event.reading_night.2.text: A snowdrop. Pressed. It kept my place since winter. For the lamp.
event.reading_night.2.why: his pressed-leaf habit, offered to the room instead of words

event.story_notes_dorian.intro.text: Oh. That wasn't for you to see. ...Paper's easier than faces.
event.story_notes_dorian.intro.why: caught, and the excuse is the confession

dlg.story.notes.dorian.0.text: A folded note sits half under the door. Dorian's hand is still on it.
dlg.story.notes.dorian.0.why: third-person present; the frozen hand is the joke

dlg.story.notes.dorian.1.why: short surrender; 'who' admits the whole run of notes

dlg.story.notes.dorian.c2.text: Slip a note back under his door.
dlg.story.notes.dorian.c2.why: playful: answers him in his own medium

dlg.story.notes.dorian.r0.text: ...A smile. No words. You speak my language.

dlg.story.notes.dorian.r1.text: Oh. You're welcome. I'll go be flustered behind a tree.

dlg.story.notes.dorian.r2.text: A note. For me. ...I'll read it in the forest. Twice.
dlg.story.notes.dorian.r2.why: keeps the note somewhere private; 'twice' shows how much

event.story_notes_dorian.after.text: Paper says what my face won't. Three more doors before dark. Don't follow.

dlg.story.scarecrow.talk.1.text: Mine says nothing. Crows hate that. I watched them for a week.
dlg.story.scarecrow.talk.1.why: his quiet, offered as field research against Tilda's smile

dlg.story.scarecrow.talk.r1.text: ...Mine. Oh. Take the runner-up home. It doesn't talk either.
dlg.story.scarecrow.talk.r1.why: winning embarrasses him; the gift is a fellow quiet one

dlg.story.scarecrow.talk.r3.text: The crows. ...They sat on both. Equally. A tie, then. Take one.
dlg.story.scarecrow.talk.r3.why: he actually watches the crows and reports like a naturalist

event.story_pumpkin_dorian.intro.text: ...It was the right size. For spores. I meant to ask. Then I didn't.
event.story_pumpkin_dorian.intro.why: an honest, flat confession of a forgetful theft

dlg.story.pumpkin.dorian.0.text: Behind the store sits a very large pumpkin. Dorian wears a very guilty face.
dlg.story.pumpkin.dorian.0.why: third-person present; the matched 'very' is the joke

dlg.story.pumpkin.dorian.2.text: ...Borrowed. For spores. It was coming back. Eventually.
dlg.story.pumpkin.dorian.2.why: replaces the unclear 'carp' line; 'eventually' is the guilt

dlg.story.pumpkin.dorian.c2.text: Grab the heavy end. Carry it back.
dlg.story.pumpkin.dorian.c2.why: playful version of offering to help carry it

dlg.story.pumpkin.dorian.r1.text: Sorry, Tilda. Truly. ...Sorry, pumpkin. You were very patient.
dlg.story.pumpkin.dorian.r1.why: apologizes to the pumpkin too, sincerely

event.story_pumpkin_dorian.after.text: It goes back tonight. Mushroom stew inside. Tilda may forgive me. The goats won't.
event.story_pumpkin_dorian.after.why: was narration in his mouth; now first person, calls back to the blamed goats

event.dorian_heart8.intro.text: ...Sit. The log. I'll show you something. Don't speak yet.

dlg.dorian.notebook.0.text: Dorian takes a small, worn notebook from his coat. He holds it shut a long moment.
dlg.dorian.notebook.0.why: the held-shut beat carries the fear

dlg.dorian.notebook.1.text: Mushrooms. Drawn. Hundreds. Nobody's seen them. ...Be gentle.
dlg.dorian.notebook.1.why: reveal and plea in the fewest words

dlg.dorian.notebook.c2.text: Draw one back. Give it a face.
dlg.dorian.notebook.c2.why: playful; sets up his reply about the face

dlg.dorian.notebook.r0.text: ...Lovely. Nobody's said that. I'll write it in the margin.
dlg.dorian.notebook.r0.why: he keeps the word where he keeps everything

dlg.dorian.notebook.r1.text: One. Take the small brown one, under the fern. It's me, mostly.
dlg.dorian.notebook.r1.why: the self-portrait as a mushroom, quietly

dlg.dorian.notebook.r2.text: It has a face. Mushrooms don't. ...This one does now. I love it.

event.dorian_heart8.after.text: {if choice:notebook.praise}You said lovely. I'll draw you a tiny one. Check your step tomorrow.{else}{if choice:notebook.ask}The brown one's yours. Don't lose it. I'll miss it. A little.{else}Your mushroom lives in the notebook now. Page one. Crooked. Perfect.{/if}{/if}
event.dorian_heart8.after.why: each branch keeps its outcome; praise points to the next offering on the step

event.dorian_birthday.intro.text: ...It's my birthday. Marcus told people. I'd rather be here. Stay a minute. Not long.
event.dorian_birthday.intro.why: Marcus callback; asks for company and limits it in one breath

dlg.dorian.birthday.c0.text: Wish him a quiet happy birthday.

dlg.dorian.birthday.c1.text: Offer a slow walk in the forest.

dlg.dorian.birthday.c2.why: the player does his offering trick back

dlg.dorian.birthday.r0.text: ...Thank you. Said quietly. That's the right size.
dlg.dorian.birthday.r0.why: he grades the wish by volume

dlg.dorian.birthday.r1.text: A walk. Slowly. There's a spot where the moss is thick.
dlg.dorian.birthday.r1.why: a specific place he wants to share

dlg.dorian.birthday.r2.text: A pinecone. Closed tight. ...It's the best one. I'm keeping it.
dlg.dorian.birthday.r2.why: he inspects it like a forager first

event.dorian_birthday.after.text: {if choice:bday.dorian.wish}Quiet words. I kept them. They fit in a pocket.{else}{if choice:bday.dorian.walk}We walked. Said little. Good birthday. Marcus can stop asking.{else}The pinecone's on my shelf. Best one. Not the forest. You.{/if}{/if}
event.dorian_birthday.after.why: the pinecone branch turns his catchphrase around

event.dorian_courtship.intro.text: ...I've been quiet a long time. One thing, then. I won't take it back. Will you court me? Slowly. Here. Quietly.

event.dorian_courtship2.intro.text: ...You said wait. I waited. The trees helped. I'll ask once more. Will you court me? Slowly. Quietly.
event.dorian_courtship2.intro.why: second ask now remembers the first answer

dlg.dorian.courtship.r0.text: ...Yes. I wasn't sure. I'll show you the quiet places. All of them. Slowly.

dlg.dorian.courtship.r1.text: Friends. ...Good. That's a lot, for me. You said it gently.
dlg.dorian.courtship.r1.why: notices how it was said rather than thanking

dlg.dorian.courtship.r2.text: Wait. Yes. I'm good at waiting. Ask any oak.

event.dorian_courtship.after.text: {if flag:choice.courtship.dorian.yes}Tomorrow, a walk. No talking until the third tree. After, maybe.{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.dorian.friends}Friends. Good word. I'll keep it somewhere mossy.{else}Take your time. I'll be in the forest. Not hiding. Waiting.{/if}{/if}
event.dorian_courtship.after.why: tightened; the third tree is a rule only he would make

event.dorian_courtship2.after.text: {if flag:choice.courtship.dorian.yes}Tomorrow, a walk. No talking until the third tree. After, maybe.{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.dorian.friends}Friends. Good word. I'll keep it somewhere mossy.{else}Still waiting, then. The oak's patient. So am I. Mostly.{/if}{/if}
event.dorian_courtship2.after.why: second wait admits a little strain

event.dorian_partners.intro.text: ...I made something. A feather, a stick, some twine. It isn't much. Sit. Hold it.

dlg.dorian.partners.0.text: ...An evening. Ours. I didn't plan past this.

dlg.dorian.partners.c2.why: the shy option in his own grammar

dlg.dorian.partners.r0.text: Soft, isn't it. I found it the day we met. Kept it. For later.
dlg.dorian.partners.r0.why: the feather has been waiting as long as he has

dlg.dorian.partners.r1.text: The forest, then. I'll show you the old oak. Best listener I know.
dlg.dorian.partners.r1.why: tightened; the oak is a character

dlg.dorian.partners.r2.text: ...Yes. This. We never needed words. Still don't.
dlg.dorian.partners.r2.why: the payoff of every silence before it

event.dorian_partners.after.text: {if choice:courtship.dorian.feather}The feather lives by my notebook now. Two good things. Three, with you.{else}{if choice:courtship.dorian.walk}We walked until the light went amber. I said six words. All good ones.{else}An hour beside you. Best thing I own. Don't tell the trees.{/if}{/if}
event.dorian_partners.after.why: drops the pinecone callback, which only holds if that birthday choice was made

event.overheard_marcus_dorian_1.l2.why: one word plus a forest yardstick

event.overheard_marcus_dorian_1.l4.text: ...You could have. You left it for me.
event.overheard_marcus_dorian_1.l4.why: notices Marcus's kindness without naming it

event.overheard_marcus_dorian_2.l4.text: ...Me too. Plane, please. That's my words for the week.
event.overheard_marcus_dorian_2.l4.why: calls back to their twelve-words-a-week rhythm

event.overheard_marcus_dorian_3.l2.text: ...Oak. Good. First door I'd close on purpose.
event.overheard_marcus_dorian_3.l2.why: tighter; the oak matters to him

event.overheard_marcus_dorian_3.l4.text: ...It's a very good door. I'll leave it open. Mostly.
event.overheard_marcus_dorian_3.l4.why: the door is trust; 'mostly' is honest

event.overheard_marcus_dorian_4.l2.text: ...Toward the trees? Good. The light comes in green there.

event.overheard_marcus_dorian_4.l4.text: ...The owl will want a name. I'll wait till it tells me.
event.overheard_marcus_dorian_4.l4.why: forest literalism; patience as a joke

event.overheard_dorian_hazel_1.l3.why: a specific bird makes the quiet real

event.overheard_dorian_hazel_2.l1.text: ...Old mushroom guide. I pressed leaves in it. Years of them.
event.overheard_dorian_hazel_2.l1.why: his pressed leaves become the gift

event.overheard_dorian_hazel_2.l3.text: ...They'd like that. Leaves like being kept.

event.overheard_dorian_hazel_3.l1.why: says the want plainly, to the one person who'd agree

event.overheard_dorian_hazel_3.l3.text: ...Then the trees can join us. They're good at it.
event.overheard_dorian_hazel_3.l3.why: the trees as fellow quiet company

adds.text: She stayed. Foxes don't, usually. You stand like a tree.
adds.why: his highest compliment, earned by the player's stillness

adds.text: There's another place. Further in. Not yet.
adds.why: ends on a promise that heart 5 pays off

adds.text: He was counting the trees. I never asked how far he got.
adds.why: the Edmund thread, as a question only

threads.dorian_heart2: Where is the other place further in, and when is 'not yet' over?
threads.dorian_heart5: Edmund was counting the trees here; how far did he get, and why count them?
threads.story_notes_dorian: Three more doors before dark: who else gets Dorian's notes?
threads.story_pumpkin_dorian: What was Dorian growing in the pumpkin, and will the goats ever be cleared?
threads.dorian_heart8: Praise: a tiny drawing will appear on the step tomorrow; otherwise the notebook now holds something of the player's.
threads.dorian_birthday: The shelf where Dorian keeps the things he's given.
threads.dorian_courtship: The walk tomorrow, and what he says after the third tree.
threads.dorian_courtship2: The walk tomorrow, and what he says after the third tree.
threads.dorian_partners: The shelf by the notebook, and the old oak he calls a listener.
threads.overheard_marcus_dorian_1: Marcus leaves words for Dorian on purpose; how long has he done that?
threads.overheard_marcus_dorian_2: Two men who spend a week's words on a plane: what are they building?
threads.overheard_marcus_dorian_3: A door Dorian will leave open, mostly: when does he close it?
threads.overheard_marcus_dorian_4: The owl outside the new window, still without a name.

notes: event.story_pumpkin_dorian.after was third-person narration in Dorian's mouth ('He's returning it...'); rewritten in first person. Director: if it was meant as narration, reassign the speaker instead.
dlg.story.pumpkin.dorian.2 'for scale. Next to the carp' made no sense in context; replaced with the spores excuse from his intro.
dorian_courtship and dorian_courtship2 share dlg.dorian.courtship.*; one set of rewrites covers both. The two .after lines now differ only in the 'wait' branch.
